svg.title: The layers, one of them yours
svg.desc: Layer diagram: your application calls the Basis2 core, which sends register reads and writes through the UART port contract to the port class you write, which drives the chip; the core and the contract are the same on every MCU.
svg.text: The layers, one of them yours
Each arrow is a call. Only the port changes from one MCU to the next.
